company_info.description: Matsuya R&D Co.,Ltd engages in the development, manufacturing, and sale of sewing system of the automotive safety systems in Japan. The company operates through Medical Healthcare, Safety System, and Others segments. It is also involved in the development, manufacturing, and sale of laser cutting machines; manufacturing of cuffs for blood pressure monitors; and production of car seat covers. The company was founded in 1982 and is headquartered in Ono, Japan. As of June 15, 2026, Matsuya R&D Co.,Ltd operates as a subsidiary of OMRON HEALTHCARE Co., Ltd.
